entry.author: KiwiRail
entry.summary:
Today is a major milestone for Auckland’s rail network - trains are back up and running after a successful summer rail upgrade and CRL timetable testing.
 
Also - the Rail Network Rebuild is finished! A  huge leap forward in the lead up to the City Rail Link opening later this year.
 
Thank you to our customers and Aucklanders for their patience and support as we improved our network to support more frequent trains.
 
Check out our highlights in this video.
